platforms.name: Soundplate Free Spotify Deezer Playlist Submission Route
platforms.country: Global / UK-based electronic music, playlist and artist tools platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official Soundplate Play states it is a free service built to help artists reach independent curators; no payment route was observed for the playlist submission listing in this run.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required before selecting playlist targets, confirming Spotify/Deezer track URL readiness, checking curator relevance and avoiding spam. No playlist was selected, no form was submitted and no track link was entered.
platforms.notes: Official Soundplate Play page exposes a public playlist submission discovery route, states artists can select playlists from the grid, lists relevant playlists such as deep house, fresh beats, garage/bass, festival and chill categories, and says the service is free for reaching independent curators.

platforms.name: Horus Music Global Distribution Playlist Radio Promotion Route
platforms.country: Global / UK-based independent artist distribution, publishing and promotion company
platforms.feeAmount: Official Horus page shows unlimited distribution from £20 per year, publishing from £3 per month, label accounts from £30 per year and India PRO from £40 per year; exact campaign/service selection requires owner approval.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for signup/login, release ownership, UPC/ISRC handling, distribution plan, editorial playlist pitching, UK/global radio promotion, publishing/sync terms, marketing services and payment authorization. No account was created and no music was sent.
platforms.notes: Official Horus Music page exposes Sign Up/Get Started routes, distribution to over 100 platforms, free UPCs/ISRCs, smartlinks, editorial playlist pitching, UK radio plugging, global radio promotion, digital PR, EPK/press services and a Send Us Your Music form route.

platforms.name: Ditto Music Distribution Playlist Sync Artist Upload Route
platforms.country: Global / UK-based independent music distribution and artist services platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official Ditto page shows sign-up/free-trial language but paid plans including Starter at $19/year, Pro at $59/year and Labels at $109/year; exact plan and add-ons require owner approval.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account creation, release upload, platform selection, Spotify/Beatport eligibility, playlist pitching, publishing/sync tools, auto-split data, terms acceptance and paid plan choice. No account was created and no release was uploaded.
platforms.notes: Official Ditto page exposes login/free sign-up, release upload to 150+ platforms, official Spotify playlist submission, music promotion, sync licensing, publishing, YouTube Content ID, pre-save links, analytics and current 2026 review/activity content.

platforms.name: UnitedMasters Artist Distribution Brand Sync Playlist Pitch Route
platforms.country: Global / US-based independent artist distribution, brand and sync platform
platforms.feeAmount: Official page shows DEBUT+ at $19.99/year, SELECT at $59.99/year, Partner by invitation and social distribution for free; any paid plan or invitation route requires owner approval.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for signup/login, artist profile, uploaded audio/artwork/metadata, plan selection, release approval, brand/sync deal eligibility, playlist/radio pitching and royalty payout setup. No account was created and no song was submitted.
platforms.notes: Official UnitedMasters page exposes sign-up/login, distribution to 150+ services, artist plans, brand and sync deal access, playlist/editorial/radio pitching, marketing tools and an FAQ process requiring account creation, upload, metadata, review and submission for approval.

platforms.name: Symphonic Digital Distribution Marketing Sync Join Route
platforms.country: Global / US-based independent music distribution, marketing and rights-management company
platforms.feeAmount: Official Symphonic page exposes Starter, Partner, NEXT and video distribution join routes plus pricing navigation; exact pricing/eligibility and plan terms require owner approval.
platforms.manualReviewReason: Owner review required for join route, distribution eligibility, account/login, music/video upload, rights management, marketing, sync licensing, platform coverage, pricing and trust/safety terms. No account was created and no assets were submitted.
platforms.notes: Official Symphonic page exposes Get Started/Join routes, login, distribution, music promotion, video distribution, royalty collection, rights management, sync licensing, pricing and delivery to 200+ DSPs including Spotify, TikTok, YouTube, Tidal, Beatport, Deezer, Pandora and Audiomack.
